test.create_query: CREATE TABLE prewhere_uniform_filter ( id UInt64, all_pass UInt8, all_drop UInt8, mixed UInt8, tail UInt8, almost_all UInt8, payload UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO prewhere_uniform_filter SELECT number, 2, 0, toUInt8(number % 2), toUInt8(number % 8192 < 8190), toUInt8(number != 9999999), number FROM numbers(10000000)
